grok-4.6.notes: Current desktop flagship. Use only if cheaper presets fail identity/edition matching.

grok-4.3.notes: Best accuracy/cost on a key already present. Official replacement for retired Grok 4.1 Fast. Same tool-calling family, about half the output price of 4.6, no high-reasoning tax.

qwen-plus.notes: Balanced Qwen Token Plan model with vision and tool calling. Main brain for shopping; Token Plan Credits vary with tokens, thinking, and tools.

qwen-max.notes: Stronger Token Plan main brain for current-market planning, architecture coverage, and reliable multi-tool research. Keep Qwen Flash limited to auxiliary chores.

qwen-flash.notes: Fast Token Plan model for auxiliary chores, not shopping judgment. Token Plan Credits vary with tokens, thinking, and tools.

deepseek-v4-pro.notes: Best cheap Chinese *text* agent model (official off-peak). Text-only — it rejects images. Needs DEEPSEEK_API_KEY. Do not use if the turn must see a screenshot; label OCR stays local/zero-LLM.

deepseek-v4-flash.notes: Official DeepSeek cheap *text* tier. Tool calls yes, images no. Off-peak list price. Needs DEEPSEEK_API_KEY.

deepseek-v4-flash-vision.notes: Experimental DeepSeek vision model (Aug 2026). Same Flash price; accepts images + tool calls. Text V4 Flash/Pro cannot see images. Needs DEEPSEEK_API_KEY.
